# ZoomGuru - full context

ZoomGuru is a desktop application for Windows that helps a candidate answer
questions during a live job interview. It is a single product. Earlier versions
of this site also advertised a mock interviewer, a document copilot and an
answer-scoring tool; those are not part of what is sold here.

## What it does

The app runs as a transparent overlay on the candidate's screen. During an
interview it captures the interviewer's question through the microphone,
transcribes it, and generates an answer that is written into the overlay a word
at a time. The candidate reads from it while speaking.

The overlay is marked as protected content at the operating-system level. Screen
capture software is refused its pixels, so it does not appear in a Zoom, Google
Meet or Microsoft Teams share, and it does not appear in a recording. It is
visible on the candidate's own monitor only.

Because it listens to the microphone and draws on the screen, it does not
integrate with the meeting software and works the same way regardless of which
one is used.

## The four ways to use it

1. Live copilot (Ctrl+Shift+L). Press once when a question lands. The answer
   begins streaming immediately. Fallback shortcut Ctrl+Alt+L.
2. Auto mode (Ctrl+Shift+D). Voice detection watches for the end of each
   question and answers without any keypress, for the rest of the call.
   Best for rapid back-and-forth rounds. Fallback Ctrl+Alt+D.
3. Screenshot answers (Ctrl+Shift+S). Captures the screen and answers what is on
   it - a diagram, a take-home brief, a block of code - instead of the audio.
   Fallback Ctrl+Alt+S.
4. Invisible overlay (Ctrl+Shift+H hides it entirely). Fallback Ctrl+Alt+H.

Ctrl+Shift+C clears the current answer.

## Grounding

The candidate uploads a CV and pastes the job description once per role. Both
are stored on their own machine and attached to every request, so answers refer
to the candidate's actual experience and are framed for the specific role rather
than being generic explanations of a topic.

## Privacy

No audio, screenshots, questions or answers are written to ZoomGuru's database.
The only record kept is that a request occurred: a user ID, the request type,
and a timestamp, which is what usage counting and outage detection rely on.

To generate an answer, audio is transcribed and the transcript - with the CV and
job description - is sent to an AI provider over an encrypted connection for the
duration of that request. Screenshots follow the same path. None of it is
retained afterwards and none of it is used to train models. Providers do not
receive the account name or email.

Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Every AI request must be signed by a device
key registered to the account. Sessions expire after three hours, and completing
a password reset signs every device out.

## Plans

All plans are unlimited in usage. There is no credit balance and no per-hour
meter. They differ in duration and in how many computers may be signed in
simultaneously - a limit on concurrent sessions, not on installations.

- Weekly: NGN 15,000, one week, 1 computer at a time.
- Monthly: NGN 45,000, one month, 2 computers at a time. Most commonly chosen.
- Yearly: NGN 450,000, one year, 2 computers at a time. Priced at ten months.

Payment is through Paystack in naira, supporting card, bank transfer, USSD and
Opay. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled at any time, with
access continuing to the end of the paid period.

A free trial of 30 minutes is available to every new account, tied to the
computer that claims it so it cannot be claimed repeatedly on one machine. No
card is required.

## How it compares

List prices read from each vendor's own pricing page on 27 August 2026. Both
competitors localise pricing by country and run promotions, so these figures
should be re-checked before being quoted.

- Parakeet AI: $74.90 per month, unlimited. Also sells credit packs where one
  credit is one hour of live session time.
- LockedIn AI: $54.99 per month, unlimited; $29.99 per month on quarterly
  billing. Also offers a credits option and a lifetime plan.
- ZoomGuru: NGN 45,000 per month, unlimited, roughly $29 equivalent.

ZoomGuru's position is that it is the cheaper option, and that it does not meter
by the hour while someone is being interviewed.

## Requirements and availability

Windows 10 or later. Roughly 90 MB download, 4 GB RAM. There is no macOS build
yet; the screen-capture protection the overlay depends on behaves differently on
macOS, and shipping it before that is solved would risk the overlay appearing in
a user's screen share.

Windows SmartScreen may warn about the installer because it is not yet widely
distributed. Choosing "More info" then "Run anyway" proceeds.

## Limits worth stating

- It answers what the microphone picks up. A muffled or interrupted question
  produces a worse answer.
- Auto mode answers everything it hears, including rhetorical questions and
  small talk. The manual shortcut is calmer in a discursive conversation.
- Screenshot answers capture the current screen only; content on a second
  monitor must be moved across first.
- The overlay is hidden from screen capture, not from the room. A person behind
  the candidate, or a second camera pointed at the monitor, sees what they see.
- AI-generated answers can be wrong or unsuitable and are suggestions, not fact.
- Some employers and institutions forbid outside assistance during an
  assessment. Whether using ZoomGuru is permitted is the candidate's judgement
  and the consequences are theirs.

## Refunds

A full refund is available within 7 days of a charge if the app did not work as
described and the problem was not resolved within 48 hours of being reported.
Duplicate charges, unauthorised charges, and outages exceeding 24 consecutive
hours are also refunded. Changing your mind after use, forgetting to cancel
before renewal, and local device or connectivity problems are not refunded.
